start: AI Assistant open, the owner has 3 or more credits; member Asha Verma exists

steps.action: Ask "Write a workout plan for Asha, fat loss, beginner, 4 days a week"
user_sees: A card "Workout plan": For "Asha Verma"
Goal, Level, Days a week filled in
"Anything to keep in mind (optional)" with the hint "Knee pain, no running"
A button "Write the plan"
"Writing the plan is free. Saving it uses 3 credits."
must_not: A plan written before the tap

user_sees: "Writing…" and "The AI is writing the plan from your gym’s exercises. This takes up to a minute."
must_not: The button can be tapped twice

user_sees: A sheet "Workout plan by the AI": "Check it, change anything you like, then save. Nothing goes to members before you save."
The plan named with the member's name
A save button "Save plan · 3 credits"
must_not: Exercises the gym does not have
The plan given to other members

steps.action: Change one exercise and tap save
user_sees: A done card with "Open Workout plans"
Credits three lower
must_not: Three credits taken with no plan saved

start: AI Assistant open on the start view

steps.action: Tap "See all {n} things it can do", tap the workout plan example, send it without a member name
user_sees: The card with For "Nobody yet"
must_not: A diet plan example in the list

steps.action: Write the plan, open it, pick members inside the plan, save
user_sees: Saved for the members picked
must_not: Saved for nobody without a word

start: A plan was written; the sheet was closed without saving

user_sees: The plan name and a short summary, buttons "Open the plan" and "Write it again"
The plan with the changes made before closing
must_not: The first version without the changes

steps.action: Change the goal and tap "Write it again"
user_sees: A new plan for the new goal; still free
must_not: A credit for the second writing

start: A written plan is open; the owner has 2 credits

user_sees: "Ask MettleUp for credits"
The plan sheet closes and the credits sheet opens; the plan stays on the card

steps.action: Ask for a plan for a name not on the list
user_sees: "Nobody called “{name}” is on your members list. You can pick members in the plan before you save it."

steps.action: The AI sends back a plan that cannot be used, or the internet drops while writing
user_sees: "The AI wrote a plan that could not be used. Try again." or a calm internet line; the card is as before

start: A plan was written and opened

steps.action: Save it; the save fails on the server
user_sees: The reason and "Your credits were given back."; the plan is still open to try again
must_not: Three credits kept with no plan

user_sees: The done card

steps.action: On the done card, try to write or save again
user_sees: Only "Open Workout plans"
must_not: A second copy of the plan

user_sees: The request with "Done · 3 credits"; a plan written but never saved shows "Not sent"
must_not: A written but unsaved plan shown with credits

start: The owner asks for a plan for a named member with an injury note

steps.action: Type "Knee pain" in the note box and tap "Write the plan"
user_sees: The plan
must_not: The member's name, record or phone number sent to the AI with the injury
A mobile number in the note sent as digits

user_sees: Nothing in the member's app
must_not: The member sees a plan that was never saved
